exposure: maternal exposure to PM2.5 during pregnancy
maternal exposure to ambient fine particulate matter (PM(2.5))
outcome: fetal BDNF level in cord blood
cohort: 711 mother-infant pairs from the Shanghai Birth Cohort
finding: Maternal PM2.5 exposure during the second trimester was significantly associated with decreased BDNF levels in cord blood, particularly in infants delivered vaginally and male infants.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries had higher BDNF levels in cord blood than cesarean deliveries.
